name: Phoenix Lights
description: A widely witnessed series of unidentified aerial lights observed across Arizona and parts of Nevada on the evening of 13 March 1997. Two distinct events occurred — a high-altitude V-formation moving south, and a later set of stationary lights over the Estrella Mountains south of Phoenix — both later attributed by U.S. Air Force investigators to A-10 Thunderbolt II aircraft and illumination flares from Operation Snowbird training exercises.
origin: A single-event phenomenon localized to the southwestern United States — southern Nevada through Phoenix and surrounding Arizona to the Tucson area.
